stories.title: North Wales Police warns renters over adverts for properties that do not exist
stories.summary: North Wales Police has warned people looking for somewhere to rent that criminals are advertising properties they do not own, cannot let, or which do not exist at all. stories.title: AI skills gap in the spotlight as Coleg Cambria launches business programme

stories.title: Connah’s Quay swimmer Rhys Darbey wins Commonwealth Games bronze in Glasgow
stories.summary: Connah’s Quay swimmer Rhys Darbey has won a Commonwealth Games bronze medal in Glasgow after the team-mate who beat him to third place was disqualified.
